transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Thursday, August 27. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Haryana's Ankit Balyan who sang 'Court Mein Goli Marenge' gunned down outside gym. Haryanvi singer Ankit Balyan was shot dead outside a gym in Shamli district. Four assailants on two motorcycles opened fire as Balyan exited the gym. Police are examining CCTV footage and investigating a possible link to Haryana. Protests erupted after the murder, with demonstrators blocking a major road. SC judge complains against Rajasthan acting CJ; CJI Surya Kant seeks response. ustice Mehta, who also hails from Rajasthan HC, has accused Justice Sharma of lacking in leadership qualities and alleged there was maladministration and malpractice on both judicial and administrative sides of HC. CJI Kant told TOI that the matter can be resolved only as per the established mechanism. "The Supreme Court cannot allow individual complaints concerning judges to be determined through competing claims in the media," he said. Northeast's first GM, 17-yo Mayank and pupil Pratitee become Asia's chess champions. A remarkable teacher-student story from the Asian Junior Chess Championships, where India's 94th GM and Northeast's first GM, 17-year-old Mayank Chakraborty, and his 13-year-old pupil Pratitee Bordoloi won the classical titles in Mumbai. The story explores their three-month mentoring journey, the pressure of being top seeds, Pratitee's WGM norm, and Mayank's rise while balancing his own career with mentoring. Delhi model, 21, dies after being stabbed multiple times in abdomen inside home. In a shocking development, a 21-year-old woman was discovered murdered in her west Delhi apartment. The police have named Imran, a gym trainer, as the suspected perpetrator who absconded after the crime. Law enforcement is combing through CCTV footage and the victim's phone for vital evidence. Friends and relatives mentioned that the trainer frequently sought her attention. Satya Nadella says Microsoft Cloud tops $100 billion revenue; analysts 'unhappy'. Recently, Microsoft announced that its Azure cloud revenue has exceeded one hundred billion dollars. Despite this impressive milestone, the tech giant continues to withhold crucial financial details from its investors. This opacity raises questions about the genuine profitability and capital intensity of Azure. In contrast, competitors like Amazon offer more detailed segment-level financial reports, leading shareholders to call for enhanced transparency regarding Microsoft's cloud and AI divisions. 'Cyber cell se bahut purana rishta hai': Samay Raina felicitated by Fadnavis. Maharashtra Cyber launched a cyber-awareness short film and anthem in Mumbai. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis stressed public awareness in tackling online fraud. Celebrities attended the event and were felicitated for their contributions. The campaign targets the "digital arrest" scam which extorts money from victims. 3 Telugu students en route to work killed in US crash. Three students from the Telugu states died in a Florida road accident. Their car collided with a tree while they were traveling to work. One student, N Rahul, died during hospital treatment after the crash. Rahul's family hopes for his mortal remains to be returned home soon. In 1984, Nasa sent 3,301 bees to space to see how they built honeycomb. In 1984, NASA's Space Shuttle Discovery embarked on a unique mission with thousands of honeybees onboard. Sent into the realm of microgravity, researchers aimed to observe if these industrious insects could build their renowned honeycombs. Despite a rocky start, resulting in some bees colliding with walls, they quickly adjusted to the weightless environment. 60 child deaths in 3 weeks, 10 in one day: Bengal hospital under scanner. West Bengal health department seeks reports from Malda Medical College Hospital. Sixty children died there during the first three weeks of August. The department is reviewing the hospital and other health facilities. Many referred children were already in critical condition upon arrival. Before and after: Nepal's green mountainside turned into debris field. Satellite images taken before and after the deadly flash flood near Nepal's border with Tibet reveal a striking change in the landscape: stretches of green mountainside visible before the disaster are now covered by a broad expanse of brown debris and sediment. Galápagos snapdragon rebounds from 6 to 28 wild plants after conservation planting. After three decades of dedicated conservation efforts, the Galápagos snapdragon, a critically endangered species, is showing promising signs of recovery. With only six wild plants left in existence, conservationists successfully nurtured them in nurseries, eventually transplanting ninety-four young shrubs into the harsh volcanic terrain of Isabela Island. The emergence of natural seedlings in their habitat marks a pivotal breakthrough, revitalizing hope for the species' future.
